title: abies alba var. compacta
intro: Abies alba var. compacta, commonly known as Dwarf Silver Fir, is a compact evergreen tree species within the Abies alba species. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Abies alba var. compacta include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
